name: Away The Bigger Carry-On
description: The cult-favorite carry-on that started a luggage revolution. Features an ejectable battery, 360-degree spinner wheels, TSA-approved lock, and an interior compression system. Fits overhead bins on most major airlines.

name: Peak Design 45L Travel Backpack
description: The ultimate travel companion for digital nomads. Expands from 35L to 45L, with dedicated laptop and camera cube compartments. Weather-resistant recycled nylon shell and hideaway shoulder straps for checking.

name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Headphones
description: Industry-leading noise cancellation for long flights. 30-hour battery life, speak-to-chat auto-pause, multipoint connection for seamless device switching, and crystal-clear call quality.

name: Anker 737 Power Bank (24,000mAh)
description: Never run out of power again. 140W max output charges MacBooks and phones simultaneously. Smart digital display shows remaining capacity and charging speed. TSA-approved capacity.

name: Patagonia Nano Puff Jacket
description: Lightweight, packable warmth for unpredictable travel weather. 60g PrimaLoft insulation stays warm when wet, and the whole jacket stuffs into its own pocket. Fair Trade Certified sewn.

name: Osprey Ultralight Packing Cubes Set
description: Set of 3 double-sided packing cubes in small, medium, and large. Mesh tops for visibility, compression zips for space saving. Weighs just 4.5 oz total. Lifetime guarantee.

name: Apple AirTag 4-Pack
description: Never lose your luggage again. Precision Finding with Ultra Wideband, global Find My network, and a replaceable battery that lasts over a year. Water-resistant and built to last.

name: Allbirds Tree Dasher 2 Running Shoes
description: The ultimate travel shoe: lightweight, breathable, and versatile enough for city exploring or light hiking. Machine washable eucalyptus fiber upper and carbon-negative SweetFoam sole.

name: Rimowa Essential Check-In L
description: German-engineered perfection in polycarbonate. The grooved design is not just iconic - it adds structural integrity. Features TSA-approved locks, multiwheel system, and Flex-Divider organization.

name: Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition
description: 32GB storage for your entire travel library. Wireless charging, auto-adjusting warm light, and 10 weeks of battery life. Waterproof for beach and poolside reading. Thinner and lighter than ever.

name: Matador FreeRain28 Waterproof Backpack
description: Ultralight 28L daypack that packs into its own pocket. Fully waterproof with welded seams, padded back panel, and comfortable shoulder straps. Perfect for day trips from your accommodation.

name: Uniqlo Ultra Light Down Vest
description: Premium down insulation that weighs almost nothing. Packs into its included pouch smaller than a water bottle. Layer it under a jacket or wear solo on cool evenings. Water-repellent finish.
